metadata.title: Out-of-Fold (OOF) Model Error Diagnosis and Provenance Catalog
metadata.evaluation_protocol: Leak-Proof Cluster-Stratified Murcko Scaffold 5-Fold Cross-Validation (Zero In-Sample Leakage)

cases.source_dataset: Octant HLM Microsomal TDI Assay (Curated Set)
cases.rationale: The baseline 2D model predicted low risk (P=0.042) because simple phenolic diols lack traditional heterocyclic alert motifs. Physics augmentation further lowered probability (P=0.018) due to high oxidation potential. However, in microsomal incubation with NADPH, resorcinol undergoes cytochrome-mediated oxidation to reactive 1,4-benzoquinone and hydroxy-benzoquinone electrophiles that inactivate CYP3A4.

cases.display_label: False Negative (Dangerous Escape): OCNT-2316767 (Chlorophenyl Quinoline Amide)
cases.source_dataset: Octant HLM Microsomal TDI Assay (Curated Set)
cases.rationale: Predicted safe (2D P=0.030, Augmented P=0.016) under grouped scaffold CV due to bulky peptide-like topology, despite OpenADMET assay active label (1) driven by quinoline oxidation to electrophilic arene oxides.

cases.display_label: False Positive (False Alarm): OCNT-2308817 (Sterically Shielded Pyrimidine)
cases.source_dataset: Octant HLM Microsomal TDI Assay (Curated Set)
cases.rationale: Over-flagged as toxic (2D P=0.907, Augmented P=0.915) due to high piperazine and pyrimidine heterocycle alert density, whereas OpenADMET assay records safe phenotype (0) because the isopropyl branch sterically blocks Compound I ferryl-oxo approach.

cases.display_label: False Positive (False Alarm): OCNT-2317273 (Isoxazole Pyridine Analog)
cases.source_dataset: Octant HLM Microsomal TDI Assay (Curated Set)
cases.rationale: Model over-relied on nitrogen-rich heterocycles, predicting severe TDI (2D P=0.856, Augmented P=0.898), whereas OpenADMET assay records safe phenotype (0) where metabolic clearance proceeds through non-bioactivating glucuronidation pathways.
